kb3ryppw.baseName: Charles Bentley 2ft Pre-Lit Faux Christmas Tree in Hessian Base - White
kb3ryppw.variantName: Charles Bentley 2ft Pre-Lit Faux Christmas Tree in Hessian Base - White
kb3ryppw.sourceDescription: This 2ft snowy tree is designed for the spaces that don't suit a full-sized tree – windowsills, bedside tables, desks, and dining tables. Snow-dusted white-tipped branches sit in a hessian base that gives it a neat, self-contained look without the need for a separate stand or pot. It's ready to place and display. 30 warm white LEDs are pre-woven throughout for a steady, warm glow. Battery powered and fully wire-free, it can be positioned anywhere in the room without a socket nearby. A built-in digital timer runs an 8 hours on / 16 hours off cycle, so the lights switch themselves on and off each day. Light branch shaping required. Unpack, shape the branches by hand for the fullest appearance, switch on the lights, and it's done. Ideal for: Windowsills, bedside tables, desks, dining tables, home offices, and any space where a small but fully formed Christmas tree makes the difference. Please Note: For indoor use only. Batteries not included – Requires 3x AA batteries. CE certified. Handle the frosted finish with care. Branches require light shaping by hand after unboxing. Features: • Snow-dusted branches in a hessian base – a self-contained styled display piece that needs no stand no pot and no extra decoration • Frosted white-tipped branches for genuine fullness at this scale • Battery powered with a built-in 8-hour digital timer – fully wire-free place it anywhere without needing a socket nearby • Hessian base provides a stable neat finish without a separate stand • Lights: 30 pre-lit warm white LEDs • Power: Battery powered | Digital timer: 8 hours on / 16 hours off Includes: • 1x 2ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree with hessian base Materials: • Plastic (branches with frosted finish) • Hessian (base) Dimensions: • H61, L43, W43cm Weights: • Approx. 1kg Colours: • White (frosted/snow finish) • Brown/natural (hessian base) Additional Info: • Lights: Simple on/off operation no settings to adjust. • Power: Battery powered – Requires 3x AA batteries. Wire free. CE certified. • Timer: Built-in digital timer – 8 hours on / 16 hours off. • Assembly: Shape branches by hand after unboxing for the fullest appearance. • Storage: Store in a cool dry place between seasons. • Care: Handle the frosted finish gently. Wipe lightly with a dry cloth if needed. Keep away from open flames. Dimensions: H61, W43, D43cm Warning: indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. Use only 3 aa batteries with correct polarity; do not mix old and new batteries or different battery types. Remove exhausted batteries and remove batteries before long-term storage. Keep batteries and the product away from young children and pets. Do not use if the battery compartment, wiring or lights are damaged. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

vtneryqt.variantName: Christmas Tree World 12ft Pre-Lit Ultra Slim Mixed Pine Christmas Tree
vtneryqt.sourceDescription: No longer does lack of space mean you can't have a realistic tree! When you choose the Pre-Lit Ultra Slim Mixed Pine tree, you get the best of our realistic trees in a skinny silhouette ideal for those who have limited space but still want a luxurious festive feature! Incorporating PE plastic-moulded branch tips with traditional high-quality PVC branches, our Pre-Lit Ultra Mixed Pines provide full, gap-free foliage that suit decorations wonderfully! They're also one of our fastest trees to erect, giving you extra time to relax with the family. You'll also be pleased to find that this 12ft slim Christmas tree includes a mixture of hinged and attached/fold-down branches, making the branches easy to bend into shape. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. gaa7axvj.baseName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
gaa7axvj.variantName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
gaa7axvj.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 9ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine Half Tree. Its half-tree design combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 400 multi-function warm white LED lights and a generous front profile. Measuring 142cm wide and 80cm deep, it sits neatly against a wall or in a corner, leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Broad lower branches and a classic, tapered shape create a full front display in rooms where floor space is limited. Short-cut pine needle outer branches and inner PVC tips add depth and fullness. Natural green shades and subtle brown detailing create a lovely backdrop for decorations. The fitted warm white LEDs highlight the foliage, with multiple lighting effects to suit your festive display. The tree comes in four sections, with flexible branches for easy shaping and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 9ft • Pre-lit: 400 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 1,688 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree dimensions: 142cm wide × 80cm deep • Design: Half tree for positioning against a wall or in a corner • Construction: Attached flexible branches for easy positioning and shaping • Assembly: Four tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 70cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in one carton • Carton dimensions: 128cm × 35cm × 37cm • Weight: 18.70kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
